purpose: Fail closed when a test couples an exact population count to live refreshed site/data or warehouse bulk proof receipts. Scheduled first-class refresh and warehouse rematerialization rewrite those artifacts; exact pins force hand-restamping and block unattended merges.

permitted_shapes.summary: Load the population from a committed fixture under test/fixtures/ and keep exact asserts against that frozen vintage.

Assert a property that survives refresh: a non-empty floor that still fails on an empty set, a complement that sums to the whole, required keys, ordering, or equality between independently derived views of the same committed input.

scope.note: Governs exact-count asserts only when a test loads one of the listed refreshed site/data or warehouse proof artifacts and the asserted expression references that load binding. The default guard run discovers those test files by content under test/ and worker/test/, including helper-based loads, JSON module imports, and join(WAREHOUSE_DIR, "receipts", "proof", "…") forms; it does not limit the scan to a fixed file allowlist. Paths that only appear in string arrays or non-load calls stay unscanned. Exact counts against committed fixtures are allowed. Grow these artifact lists only when a later refresh proves another member.

empirical_starting_set.source: Scheduled first-class refresh pull request restamps that invalidated exact pins
empirical_starting_set.note: Provenance of the suites a real refresh invalidated. Kept covered by the default scan and is not the scan allowlist; content discovery is authoritative for which files are checked. warehouse_bulk is provenance for warehouse proof rematerialization restamps.
